``json
{
  "id":        "<content hash>",

  "stream":    "VAULT | LEDGER | CALENDAR | NOTIFIER | LEARNING | CAMPAIGN | TALK",

vocab.definition: Governed personal portal. One per USER. Composes INTEL + CHAT + COIN into a unified personal surface.

Unified chronological JOIN across all event sources (VAULT, LEDGER, CALENDAR, NOTIFIER, LEARNING, CAMPAIGN, TALK). Read-only projection — never duplicates. The joint lane for all cross-axiomatic intel.
A view into a governed data domain. Each lane wires to existing services. 8 lanes: TIMELINE, SERVICES, INTEL, ECON, VAULT, IDENTITY, MEDIA, GOV.
A source event feed that TIMELINE reads. Each stream maps to an existing service (VAULT, LEDGER, CALENDAR, NOTIFIER, LEARNING, CAMPAIGN, TALK).
The canonical wrapper shape that TIMELINE uses to project source events into a unified chronological view. Contains id, ts, stream, type, scope, principal, summary, ref, primitive, meta.
The STAR surface — a single-page interface with lane tabs. The USER's entry point to their governed life.
